title: oriented glyph contour
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate vtkContourWidget with oriented glyph representation on a medical image slice.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkBoundedPlanePointPlacer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkBoundedPlanePointPlacer.html) — bounded plane point placer.
- [vtkCommand](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCommand.html) — command.
- [vtkContourWidget](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkContourWidget.html) — contour widget.
- [vtkImageActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageActor.html) — image actor.
- [vtkImageShiftScale](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageShiftScale.html) — image shift scale.
- [vtkOrientedGlyphContourRepresentation](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkOrientedGlyphContourRepresentation.html) — oriented glyph contour representation.
- [vtkPlane](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPlane.html) — defines an implicit plane function.
- [vtkVolume16Reader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkVolume16Reader.html) — volume16reader.
- [vtkWidgetEvent](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkWidgetEvent.html) — widget event.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
